caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a round wooden container with a lid, positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The container is bulbous in shape with a slightly narrow neck, a rounded main body, and a circular base that flares outward, providing stable support. The lid fits snugly on top and features a small, conical knob or finial at the center for gripping. The wood grain is clearly illustrated, showing swirling patterns and variations in tone, primarily in shades of brown ranging from reddish-brown to deeper, walnut hues. The smooth surface of the container is rendered with subtle highlights and shadows, giving it a realistic three-dimensional appearance. There is no other object or decoration within the composition, and the artist's signature, "Lloyd Charles Lemcke," is written in cursive script below the container on the lower center of the image.
title: Spice Box
